items.title: File Einspruch against the 2025 income tax assessment
items.quote: Legen Sie ihn innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Beispielau ein, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The letter is dated Thu 19.11.2026. For a tax assessment sent by ordinary post, § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO deems it delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Mon 23.11.2026 (that day is already a business day, no shift needed). Under § 108 Abs. 1 AO / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month Einspruch period starts the next day; under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB it ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. Wed 23.12.2026. That day is a Wednesday, not a Saturday/Sunday/holiday in NRW, so no further shift applies (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO).

warnings: The deemed-delivery date (4 days after the letter's date) was used because the letter was sent by ordinary post; if it actually arrived later or was formally served, the one-month Einspruch deadline could be later than 2026-12-23 and should be re-checked against the envelope.

The refund of 539,00 € is to be paid into IBAN DE14 5139 0000 0074 4022 18, which the letter states is 'Ihr Konto' (your account); the IBAN is well-formed, but confirm it is indeed your own account before relying on an incoming payment.
